# Probation
## On this page
- [Employee entitlements during probation](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/starting-employment/probation#employee-entitlements)

## Employee entitlements during probation
While on probation, employees continue to receive the same entitlements as someone who isn’t in a probation period. This includes the entitlements in the [National Employment Standards](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/employment-conditions/national-employment-standards).

If hired on a full-time or part-time basis, an employee on probation is entitled to accrue and access their paid leave entitlements, such as annual leave and sick leave.

If an employee doesn’t pass their probation, they are still entitled to:

- receive notice when employment ends
- have their unused accumulated annual leave hours paid out.

# Dismissal
## Minimum notice period
### Notice during probation periods
Employees are entitled to a notice period even if their employment ends during their probation period.
